hints.title: Pair-Based State Definition
hints.text: A Fibonacci sequence is uniquely determined by its two most recent terms.

hints.title: Value Index Mapping
hints.text: Index each number in the strictly increasing array to check in constant time whether arr[i] minus arr[j] exists.

hints.title: Pairwise Transition Recurrence
hints.text: For each pair (j, i), if k exists such that arr[k] plus arr[j] equals arr[i] with k less than j, extend length from pair (k, j) plus one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: State table indexed by pairs of elements extended in O(1) per pair.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating sequences from all pairs naively without storing prior lengths results in O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lookup table for transitions requires O(N^2) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use pair state (j, i) to capture the two-term recurrence.
